description: Defines data transfer objects (DTOs) for TV Channel information, including TvChannelDto which maps API data to domain models, and a response wrapper TvChannelsResponse.

classes.name: TvChannelDto
classes.description: Data Transfer Object representing TV channel data received from API, with annotations for JSON serialization and fields for channel metadata.

classes.name: TvChannelsResponse
classes.description: Wrapper for list of TvChannelDto objects, representing the API response containing multiple TV channels.
